title: Projective enriched diagram localization descends over simplicial bases
statement:
Use combinatorial simplicial model categories and projective enriched diagrams of [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus], the explicit coherent realization $\mathfrak C$ by simplex colimits of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching], and enriched simplicial localization and Dwyer--Kan homotopy limits of [lem-coef-simplicial-localization-comparison-calculus]. Fix such a model category $\mathcal A$ and enlarge universes so its diagram categories are small. For any small simplicial set $S$, put
$$\mathcal E_{\mathcal A}(S)=(\mathcal A^{\mathfrak C[S]^{\mathrm{op}}})^f[W_S^{-1}],$$
where $f$ means projectively fibrant diagrams and $W_S$ consists of objectwise weak equivalences between them. Restriction of enriched diagrams defines the contravariant functoriality. For every small family $(S_j)$, restriction exhibits $\mathcal E_{\mathcal A}(\coprod_jS_j)$ as the homotopy product of the $\mathcal E_{\mathcal A}(S_j)$, computed by the ordinary product after functorial fibrant replacement in simplicial categories, including the empty family. For every pushout $P=B\amalg_A C$ of small simplicial sets in which $A\to B$ is a monomorphism, its restriction cone exhibits $\mathcal E_{\mathcal A}(P)$ as the homotopy pullback of
$$\mathcal E_{\mathcal A}(B)\longrightarrow\mathcal E_{\mathcal A}(A)\longleftarrow\mathcal E_{\mathcal A}(C).$$
For an increasing sequence $S_0\subseteq S_1\subseteq\cdots$ with union $S$, the restriction cone exhibits $\mathcal E_{\mathcal A}(S)$ as the homotopy inverse limit of the $\mathcal E_{\mathcal A}(S_n)$. These are assertions in the Dwyer--Kan homotopy theory of enriched simplicial categories, retaining all enriched mapping sets, not assertions obtained by first identifying those categories with infinity categories. No right-fibration classification or coherent-nerve equivalence is assumed.
